Summarize Differences Between Trial Planning Objects

Source: R/class_trial_comparison.R
summary.TrialComparison.Rd

Summarizes differences between the object profiles in a trial comparison.

The TrialComparisonSummary method refreshes a summary from its underlying comparison, retaining stored display settings unless explicitly overridden. This also supports %vs% chains followed by summary(...).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'TrialComparison'
summary(
  object,
  ...,
  digits = NA_integer_,
  maxParameters = NA_integer_,
  maxProfiles = NA_integer_,
  maxObjects = NA_integer_,
  maxValues = NA_integer_,
  output = c("all", "title", "overview", "body"),
  harmonizeColumnNames = TRUE,
  textMode = c("wrap", "truncate", "full"),
  width = NA_integer_,
  showAll = NA
)

# S3 method for class 'TrialComparisonSummary'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A TrialComparison or an existing TrialComparisonSummary.

...

Further arguments. Currently unused.

digits

Display rounding only; exact values determine differences.

maxParameters

Maximum number of differing parameters shown, across all sections. Increase this to inspect further differences.

maxProfiles

Maximum number of distinct profiles shown per parameter.

maxObjects

Maximum object numbers/names listed per profile.

maxValues

Maximum profile values shown per preview.

output

One of "all", "title", "overview", or "body".

harmonizeColumnNames

If TRUE (default), compare the harmonized columns described in getComparison(). If FALSE, compare the original parameter names, as in as.data.frame(object, harmonizeColumnNames = FALSE).

textMode

Console text handling: "wrap" (default) wraps complete text, "truncate" shows compact previews with an explicit shortening notice, and "full" writes complete text without automatic wrapping. Markdown always retains complete text in its profile tables.

width

Console line width, at least 20 characters. Defaults to getOption("width", 80L). Long unbroken words can exceed this width.

showAll

If TRUE, lift all four max* limits and disable text truncation. Wrapping remains active when textMode = "wrap". Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A TrialComparisonSummary inheriting from SummaryFactory. Its parameterInfo contains metadata, full exact profiles and object group IDs. The displayed summary is a snapshot; call summary() again after changing an underlying object. The harmonizeColumnNames attribute of parameterInfo records the selected naming mode for plotting and R-code reconstruction. Input roles take precedence when roles differ across the compared object types.

Details

Constant numeric vector cells compare equal to their scalar value regardless of vector length. Nonconstant vectors, missing values, and their positions remain part of the exact comparison. The stored comparison data are unchanged. This value normalization also applies when column-name harmonization is disabled. Plotting a summary retains its selected column-name mode unless custom data are supplied.

Parameter captions are resolved separately for each original object, including its design when a parameter comes from that design. parameterInfo$paramName retains the column names selected by harmonizeColumnNames; paramCaption contains the display label and paramCaptions contains captions in object order (NA for absent parameters). These captions are captured with the summary. Distinct object-specific captions are shown together and identified alongside the corresponding object labels; they do not change exact value-profile grouping. Unnamed entries are labelled by their calculation or design type and collection position. The overview and these type labels are captured with the summary. The legend explains exact profile comparison and mentions NA only when displayed profiles contain missing values. Titles distinguish designs, sample size calculations, power calculations, and power simulations. Mixed comparisons use a design plan comparison title; empty comparisons retain the general trial comparison title. Markdown output presents each differing parameter as a table with one row per displayed profile and columns labelled by stage and situation. Scalar profiles use a Value column. Blank cells indicate coordinates absent from a profile; explicit missing values are shown as NA. The display limits also apply to these tables, with omitted values and profiles indicated explicitly.

A NULL display argument reads its setting through .getEnvironmentVariable(). Explicit arguments take precedence over environment variables, which take precedence over R options and defaults. The four default limits are 12 parameters, 3 profiles, 6 objects and 4 values. R options use the prefix rpact.comparison.summary. followed by the argument name: maxParameters, maxProfiles, maxObjects, maxValues, textMode, width or showAll. The corresponding environment variables are RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_MAX_PARAMETERS, RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_MAX_PROFILES, RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_MAX_OBJECTS, RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_MAX_VALUES, RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_TEXT_MODE, RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_WIDTH and RPACT_COMPARISON_SUMMARY_SHOW_ALL. Settings are captured when the summary is created. For a complete display use summary(x, showAll = TRUE); for a compact display use textMode = "truncate".
